# wirebound

> wirebound is a web screen-design tool. People draw page designs — a menu tree of pages, each page a tree of catalog components — in a browser editor; coding agents read the designs, comment on them and edit them through an MCP server. The `wireb` CLI only reads them (`wireb --help`). This file is the same for every wirebound server and carries no data from this one.

All server paths below are relative to the origin that served this file.

## Connect an agent

The agent runs `wireb-mcp`, a stdio MCP server, inside the implementation repository. Project, server and token are not tool arguments: the repository file `.wirebound.json` names the server and project, and the token lives outside the repository.

1. Get the tools: build the wirebound source repository (`pnpm install && pnpm build`). The CLI is `node packages/cli/dist/bin.js` and the MCP server is `node packages/mcp/dist/bin.js`; `pnpm link --global` inside `packages/cli` and `packages/mcp` puts `wireb` and `wireb-mcp` on PATH.
2. Find the project id: it is in the editor URL, `/projects/<project id>`. You need a user account on this server that is a member of the project (viewer or above).
3. In the implementation repository: `wireb init --server <this origin> --project <project id>` writes `.wirebound.json` (commit it; it holds no secret).
4. `wireb login --email <you>` asks for the password, issues an API token for that one project and stores it in `~/.wirebound/credentials.json` (mode 600). `WIREB_TOKEN` overrides it. A person revokes tokens in the account settings ("API 토큰" section) or by removing the member from the project.
5. Register the server with the host from the repository directory, e.g. `claude mcp add wirebound -- wireb-mcp`, or `{ "mcpServers": { "wirebound": { "command": "wireb-mcp", "args": [] } } }` in `.mcp.json`.

Typical flow: `list_pages` → `get_page` → implement → `add_comment` where the code and the design disagree → `validate`. Edit the design with `patch_page` only when a person asks for it.

## MCP tools

### list_pages

Menu tree and page list of the bound project. Each page `path` is the argument of the other tools.

Arguments: none.

### get_page

One page: document, node outline (`nodes[].id`, `nodes[].path`), comments, interaction sentences and `headSeq`. Unknown or ambiguous paths return candidates instead.

- `path` (string, required) — Page path from `list_pages`, e.g. `Admin/Members/List`. A `page:` prefix is accepted.

### patch_page

Edit the page document with JSON Patch, through the same pipeline as human edits. Rejected with reason `stale` (409: re-read with `get_page`, rebuild the ops), `locked` (423: a person is editing that area — wait) or `rejected`. Never retries.

- `path` (string, required) — Page path.
- `baseSeq` (integer ≥ 0, required) — The `headSeq` from `get_page` (or from the previous successful edit).
- `ops` (array of objects, required) — RFC 6902 ops (add, remove, replace, move, test — not copy), at most 200. Paths under `/root` (use `nodes[].path`), `/viewStates` or `/version`.

### add_comment

Comment on one node — how an implementer reports back to the design. Numbering a node changes the document and raises `headSeq`.

- `path` (string, required) — Page path.
- `nodeId` (string, required) — Node id from `get_page` `nodes[].id`.
- `body` (string, required) — Comment text.

### validate

Run the lint rules. Findings are a normal result, not an error. Naming rules come from `.wirebound.json`.

- `path` (string, optional) — Optional page path; without it the whole project is checked.

## Page document

A page is a JSON document. Edits are JSON Patch against it; `nodes[].path` from `get_page` is the JSON Pointer of each node.

- `version` (integer, required) — Document format version. The server stores and returns version 4.
- `root` (node, required) — The root node — always a `Page`.
- `viewStates` (array, optional) — Optional named screen states (`{ id, name, parent?, description? }`), at most 20, names 1–30 characters, nesting at most 3 deep, `description` free text up to 2000 characters (omit it rather than send a blank one). Nodes refer to them from `visibility`.

### Node

- `id` (string, required) — Unique within the document. Pattern `[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}`.
- `type` (string, required) — A component type from the catalog below.
- `alias` (string, optional) — Optional human name for the node, 1–60 characters, no surrounding spaces or line breaks. Need not be unique.
- `props` (object, optional) — The component's props (see the catalog). Omitted props take their defaults.
- `variant` (string, optional) — A theme variant name. The theme decides which values exist; the document doesn't validate it.
- `weight` (integer, optional) — Integer 1–12: share of the parent — free width in a `Flex`, columns spanned in a `Grid`, pairs spanned in a `FormTable` or a `SearchForm` with `columns`. Ignored elsewhere.
- `visibility` (object, optional) — `{ mode: "only" | "except", states: [...] }` — show the node only in (or hide it in) those view states and their descendants. `"default"` is the base screen. Omitted: visible in every state.
- `marker` (integer, optional) — Comment number (positive integer). The server assigns it when the first comment lands on the node; do not invent one.
- `interactions` (array, optional) — What happens on user events (see Interactions).
- `children` (node[], optional) — Child nodes in the body zone. Only components that declare a `body` zone take them.
- `zones` (object, optional) — Named child zones: `{ <zone name>: [nodes] }`. Only the zones a component declares (see the catalog); a missing key is an empty zone. Patch paths: `…/zones/<zone name>/<index>` (add a first node with `…/zones/<zone name>` and value `[node]`, or `…/zones` with `{ <zone name>: [node] }` when the node has no `zones`).

Nodes carry no styles. Appearance comes from the project theme.

### Interactions

`interactions` is a list of `{ on, actions }`. `on` is one of `click`, `change`, `select`, `submit`; `actions` run in order. Action `type`s:

- `setProp` `{ target: <node id>, prop, value }` — set a prop of another node.
- `setVisible` `{ target: <node id>, value: boolean }` — show or hide a node.
- `switchTab` `{ target: <TabPanel node id> }` — open that tab of its parent `Tabs`.
- `navigate` `{ target: "page:<menu path>" }` — go to another page.
- `openModal` `{ target: "page:<menu path>" }` — open another page as a modal.

A `page:` target names a page by its menu path, the same `path` the MCP tools take.

## Component catalog

Every node `type` is one of these. Props are validated against the listed shapes; unknown props are rejected. Child nodes live in zones: the `body` zone is the node's `children`, every other zone is `zones.<name>`. A component with no zones holds no child nodes. Some zones accept only certain types, and some types stand only in one zone. "Create with" lists the nodes the editor puts in a new node — the server does not add them, so add them yourself when you create one. State props are booleans that switch a visual state of the component.

### Structure — containers that arrange other nodes

#### Page

Root of one design page; everything on the page sits inside it. Only valid as the document root. Editor label: 페이지.

Zones: `body` (children) "몸통".

No props.

#### Slot

Where a layout inserts the page content. Layout documents only. Editor label: 슬롯.

Zones: none.

No props.

#### Section

A large band of the screen with its own background and spacing. Editor label: 영역.

Zones: `body` (children) "몸통".

- `compact`: boolean, default false

#### Flex

Lays children out in one row or one column. Editor label: 배치.

Zones: `body` (children) "몸통".

- `direction`: "row" | "column", default "row"
- `align`: "start" | "center" | "end" | "stretch", default "stretch"
- `justify`: "start" | "center" | "end" | "between", default "start"
- `wrap`: boolean, default false

#### Grid

Lays children out on a fixed number of columns. Editor label: 그리드.

Zones: `body` (children) "몸통".

- `columns`: integer 1–12, default 2

#### Card

A box that groups a title and its content. Editor label: 카드.

Zones: `titleSide` (zones.titleSide) "제목 옆"; `headEnd` (zones.headEnd) "머리 오른쪽"; `body` (children) "몸통"; `footer` (zones.footer) "바닥".

- `title`: string, default ""
- `subtitle`: string, default ""

#### Tabs

Splits content into tabs and shows one at a time. Each tab is a `TabPanel` child. Editor label: 탭.

Zones: `body` (children) "탭", accepts only `TabPanel`, create with `TabPanel` {"label":"탭 1"} + `TabPanel` {"label":"탭 2"}.

- `active`: integer ≥ 0, default 0

#### TabPanel

One tab of a `Tabs`: its `label` is the tab head, its children are the tab content. Only valid in the body of a `Tabs`. Editor label: 탭 패널.

Zones: `body` (children) "내용".
Stands only in the `body` zone of a `Tabs`.

- `label`: string, default "탭"

### Data — show records

#### List

Many records as a table, cards or a list. Editor label: 목록.

Zones: `headStart` (zones.headStart) "머리 왼쪽"; `headEnd` (zones.headEnd) "머리 오른쪽".

- `items`: integer 0–50, default 5
- `columns`: string[], default ["컬럼 1","컬럼 2"]
- `pagination`: boolean, default true
- `selectable`: boolean, default false
- `selected`: boolean, default false — state
- `disabled`: boolean, default false — state
- `loading`: boolean, default false — state
- `empty`: boolean, default false — state

#### Tree

Hierarchical items that expand and collapse. Editor label: 트리.

Zones: none.

- `items`: string[], default ["항목 1","항목 2"]
- `depth`: integer 1–5, default 2
- `selected`: boolean, default false — state
- `disabled`: boolean, default false — state

#### KeyValue

Label/value pairs, as on a detail screen. Editor label: 키-값 목록.

Zones: none.

- `pairs`: { key: string, value: string }[], default [{"key":"항목","value":"값"}]
- `columns`: integer 1–4, default 1

### Input — forms and fields

#### SearchForm

Search conditions that filter a list. Editor label: 검색폼.

Zones: `body` (children) "조건"; `actions` (zones.actions) "단추", create with `Button` {"label":"초기화"} + `Button` {"label":"검색"} variant "primary".

- `collapsed`: boolean, default false
- `columns`: integer 1–4, optional (no default)

#### EntryForm

A create/edit form; its body stacks form tables, headings and grids above one button row (new: one `FormTable`). Editor label: 입력폼.

Zones: `body` (children) "항목", create with `FormTable`; `actions` (zones.actions) "단추", create with `Button` {"label":"저장"} variant "primary" + `Button` {"label":"취소"}.

- `title`: string, default ""

#### FormTable

A label|value table: `columns` pairs per row, each child spans `weight` pairs (≥ `columns` = whole row); empty pairs at row ends are drawn. Zones: right of the title, a left cell over all rows (photo), the cells. Editor label: 폼 표.

Zones: `headEnd` (zones.headEnd) "머리 오른쪽"; `aside` (zones.aside) "옆 칸"; `body` (children) "칸", create with `Field` + `Field` + `Field`.

- `title`: string, default ""
- `columns`: integer 1–4, default 1

#### Field

A labelled value cell; its children are the input pieces lined up in the value cell (new: one `Input`). Editor label: 입력 필드.

Zones: `body` (children) "값", create with `Input`.

- `label`: string, default "라벨"
- `required`: boolean, default false — state

#### Input

A one-line input box; `kind` is text, number or password, `size` short, medium or long. Editor label: 입력.

Zones: none.

- `kind`: "text" | "number" | "password", default "text"
- `value`: string, default ""
- `placeholder`: string, default ""
- `size`: "short" | "medium" | "long", default "medium"
- `disabled`: boolean, default false — state
- `readonly`: boolean, default false — state
- `invalid`: boolean, default false — state

#### TextArea

A multi-line input box; fills the value cell. Editor label: 여러 줄 입력.

Zones: none.

- `value`: string, default ""
- `placeholder`: string, default ""
- `rows`: integer 1–20, default 3
- `disabled`: boolean, default false — state
- `readonly`: boolean, default false — state
- `invalid`: boolean, default false — state

#### Select

A drop-down that picks one option; `placeholder` shows while nothing is selected. Editor label: 셀렉트.

Zones: none.

- `options`: { label: string, selected?: boolean }[] (1–30 items), default [{"label":"항목 1"},{"label":"항목 2"}] — at most one option selected
- `placeholder`: string, default "== 선택 =="
- `size`: "short" | "medium" | "long", default "medium"
- `disabled`: boolean, default false — state
- `invalid`: boolean, default false — state

#### DateInput

A date input box. Editor label: 날짜.

Zones: none.

- `value`: string, default ""
- `placeholder`: string, default "YYYY-MM-DD"
- `disabled`: boolean, default false — state
- `readonly`: boolean, default false — state
- `invalid`: boolean, default false — state

#### TimeInput

A time input box. Editor label: 시간.

Zones: none.

- `value`: string, default ""
- `placeholder`: string, default "00:00"
- `disabled`: boolean, default false — state
- `readonly`: boolean, default false — state
- `invalid`: boolean, default false — state

#### CheckboxGroup

Checkboxes that pick any number of options; one option is a single checkbox. Editor label: 체크박스.

Zones: none.

- `options`: { label: string, selected?: boolean }[] (1–30 items), default [{"label":"선택"}]
- `disabled`: boolean, default false — state

#### RadioGroup

Options that pick at most one; themes may draw it as a segmented control. Editor label: 라디오 묶음.

Zones: none.

- `options`: { label: string, selected?: boolean }[] (1–30 items), default [{"label":"Y"},{"label":"N"}] — at most one option selected
- `disabled`: boolean, default false — state

#### Chip

A small tag showing a chosen value, optionally with a remove mark. Editor label: 칩.

Zones: none.

- `label`: string, default "칩"
- `removable`: boolean, default true
- `disabled`: boolean, default false — state

#### Affix

Short text between pieces (`~`, "from", `%`) or a coloured note; `tone` sets the colour. Editor label: 사이 글자.

Zones: none.

- `text`: string, default "~"
- `tone`: "default" | "muted" | "danger" | "primary", default "default"

### Action — things a user presses

#### Button

A button that triggers an action. Editor label: 버튼.

Zones: none.

- `label`: string, default "버튼"
- `disabled`: boolean, default false — state
- `loading`: boolean, default false — state

#### Link

A text link to another screen. Editor label: 링크.

Zones: none.

- `label`: string, default "링크"
- `target`: string, default ""
- `disabled`: boolean, default false — state

### Document — text, media and filler

#### Text

Headings and body text; `role` sets the size. Editor label: 텍스트.

Zones: none.

- `content`: string, default "텍스트"
- `role`: "display" | "h1" | "h2" | "h3" | "h4" | "h5" | "h6" | "body" | "caption", default "body" — selects the theme variant

#### Media

A slot for an image, video, illustration or chart. Editor label: 미디어.

Zones: none.

- `kind`: "image" | "video" | "illustration" | "chart", default "image"
- `caption`: string, default ""
- `ratio`: "16/9" | "4/3" | "1/1" | "3/4", default "16/9"

#### Divider

A line that separates content. Editor label: 구분선.

Zones: none.

- `direction`: "horizontal" | "vertical", default "horizontal" — selects the theme variant

#### Placeholder

Draws what the catalog lacks (a chip, a badge, a banner) or reserves an undesigned area. The only component whose props carry drawing values (size, colors, border, text, padding, image); empty values follow the theme. Children (body zone) replace the label. `image` is the id (sha256) of an image uploaded to this project (`POST /api/projects/:projectId/assets`) — an id the project does not hold draws as a missing image. Editor label: 자리 표시자.

Zones: `body` (children) "내용".

- `label`: string, default "미정 영역"
- `width`: integer 20–2000, optional (no default)
- `height`: integer 20–2000, optional (no default)
- `background`: string matching `^#[0-9a-f]{6}$` | "", optional (no default)
- `border`: "dashed" | "solid" | "none", default "dashed"
- `borderColor`: string matching `^#[0-9a-f]{6}$` | "", optional (no default)
- `radius`: integer 0–999, optional (no default)
- `color`: string matching `^#[0-9a-f]{6}$` | "", optional (no default)
- `fontSize`: integer 10–72, optional (no default)
- `align`: "start" | "center" | "end", default "center"
- `padding`: integer 0–200, optional (no default)
- `image`: string matching `^[0-9a-f]{64}$` | "", optional (no default)
- `imageFit`: "cover" | "contain", default "cover"

## REST API (summary)

- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (the token from `wireb login`). A token works only on routes under `/api/projects/:projectId/` of its own project — another project answers 404. It cannot open the WebSocket or manage tokens. Permission is the member role at request time: viewer < editor < owner.
- Bodies are JSON with camelCase keys. Errors: `{ "error": { "code", "message", "issues"? } }`.
- Edits are optimistic: send the `headSeq` you read as `baseSeq`. A stale `baseSeq` is 409 — re-read and rebuild, never resend the same ops on a new `baseSeq`. At most 200 ops per edit.

- `GET /api/projects/:projectId` (viewer) — The project (name, slug, your role).
- `GET /api/projects/:projectId/tree` (viewer) — Menu tree with the pages under each menu node (no page documents).
- `GET /api/projects/:projectId/pages/:pageId` (viewer) — One page with its document (`schema`) and `headSeq` — the `baseSeq` for the next edit.
- `PATCH /api/projects/:projectId/pages/:pageId/ops` (editor) — Edit the document: `{ baseSeq, ops }` (JSON Patch). 409 when `baseSeq` is stale, 423 when a person holds the area.
- `GET /api/projects/:projectId/pages/:pageId/revisions` (viewer) — Edit history, newest first (`?limit=`, `?beforeSeq=`).
- `GET /api/projects/:projectId/pages/:pageId/comments` (viewer) — Comments on the page, oldest first.
- `POST /api/projects/:projectId/pages/:pageId/comments` (editor) — Add a comment to a node: `{ nodeId, body }`. May number the node, which changes the document.
- `GET /api/projects/:projectId/snapshot` (viewer) — Read-only dump of the whole project: menu, pages with their stored documents, layouts, comments, theme binding.
- `GET /api/projects/:projectId/snapshots` (viewer) — Saved snapshots (tags), without their payload.
- `GET /api/projects/:projectId/theme` (viewer) — The project's theme binding and token values.
- `GET /api/projects/:projectId/assets` (viewer) — The project's uploaded images (`id` is what a Placeholder's `image` prop holds), used bytes and limits.
- `POST /api/projects/:projectId/assets` (editor) — Upload an image: the body is the file bytes (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, SVG — not multipart), optional `X-Asset-Name` header. Answers `{ id, … }`; the same bytes answer the same id.
- `GET /api/projects/:projectId/export` (viewer) — Download the design: `?format=html` (static bundle, zip) or `?format=pptx`.
